Boundaries.Name: hedged-read-owner
Boundaries.Contract: Retain the caller through selection and loser cleanup. Each leg owns independent failure-only storage; add only the completed result leg retries to the caller prefix, saturating at int.MaxValue, before releasing that leg. Never borrow the loser lifetime.

Boundaries.Name: hedged-read-leg
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow one independently owned leg through redirects and retirement; the race copies retry history before releasing its completed leg owner.
